card.name: Brand-name endings and component phrases
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a repeated brand name is completed or finished, such as LA or ER after a brand, or 'of' after 'component'. Also the L in 10 9 /L.

modes.label: Brand name suffix
modes.description: A short add-on like LA, ER or B following a drug brand name that was just written.
modes.example: Therapy with SUPPRELIN<< LA>> results in suppression of the pituitary

modes.label: Component of brand
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'any component' in hypersensitivity statements, just before the brand name.
modes.example: Known hypersensitivity to vonoprazan or any component<< of>> VOQUEZNA. ( 4

modes.label: Unit L in counts
modes.description: The L in a blood count unit written as 10 9 /L.
modes.example: Adjust the dose or frequency of dosing to maintain platelet count greater than or equal to 50×10 9 /<<L>>. Do not exceed 20 mg

card.plain: It fires on small bits in drug labels that sit just before a brand name repeats or a count unit ends.
